name: Find the Icon of Ravenloft
description: Find the hidden Chapel, defeat its guardians, and recover the lost Icon of Ravenloft.

objectives.description: Defeat all monsters guarding the Chapel.

specialRules.description: Once the Chapel is revealed, each player draws an Encounter Card at the start of their Villain Phase.

introText: The Heroes descend into the crypts to find the hidden Chapel and recover the Icon of Ravenloft.
victoryText: The Chapel glows with goodness, and with the Icon of Ravenloft in hand, you escape the terrors of the crypts!
defeatText: The darkness consumes you. The Chapel remains hidden, and the Icon of Ravenloft is lost forever.
